name: Makeup Pro
steps: Drag feather duster to make eyelashes bigger.
Open window so woodpecker makes freckles.
Drag cherry to lips for red lipstick look.
Shake cosmetic bottle to add pink blush.
Drag charcoal to face for gothic look.
Drag rainbow ornament to hair for glowing effect.
Wipe face and spray to create tan and eyeliner look.
Use makeup pads and drag rainbow streak to style stylist’s hair.
